title: Zen Browser profiles
whyItMatters: Zen keeps its browser profiles, history, cookies, saved logins and workspaces here. A profile on this Mac shows the browser was used and how many separate identities were kept.
source: Zen Browser GitHub, profile location discussion: macOS ~/Library/Application Support/zen - https://github.com/zen-browser/desktop/discussions/5978
notes: Each profile is a subfolder with prefs.js, history, cookies, logins and Zen workspace state. Profile names are random per install. The Linux beta uses ~/.config/zen.

cleanup.exportFirst: In Zen, export bookmarks to an HTML file and save any passwords you need from the browser's password settings.
cleanup.signOut: Sign out of Mozilla Sync in Zen settings, or disconnect this profile from the account, so the account no longer trusts this browser.
steps: Move Zen Browser to the Trash from Applications.
Delete the Zen folder named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Removes every Zen profile on this Mac: history, bookmarks, cookies, saved logins and workspaces.
